content: Root cause: The driver incorrectly restricted the combinations of RSS hash fields for IPv4 and IPv6 protocols, leading to failures when users attempted to use valid combinations that the hardware could support. Additionally, the driver did not return an error when unsupported masks were provided, which further contributed to the issues experienced by users.

buggy_stmts_infos.buggy_stmt: pr_debug("RX Hash fields_mask is not supported - UDP must be set with IPv4 or IPv6\n");
pr_debug("RX Hash fields_mask is not supported - TCP must be set with IPv4 or IPv6\n");
pr_debug("RX Hash fields_mask is not supported - both TCP SRC and DST must be set\n");
